cohort: Infants from the HELMi cohort, divided into a group with several infections (n=125) and a control group with no infections (n=122) during the first 6 months of life, matched for sex, year of birth, mode of delivery, and timing of breastmilk sample.
finding: Maternal prenatal stress, specifically related to household during the last trimester, was significantly higher in infants who experienced several infections during the first 6 months of life compared to those with no infections.
